summary: To point the portal's Support link at your own site, upgrade the Helm release in the OpenShift Developer perspective (YAML view) and add CUSTOMER_SUPPORT_URL under redhat-developer-hub.upstream.backstage.extraEnvVars; verify by hovering over Support in the portal header.
questions: How do I change the support link in self-service automation portal?
Custom support URL for the portal

answer_card.title: Set a custom support URL
answer_card.answer_md:
OpenShift console > Developer > **Helm** > your portal release > *More actions* > **Upgrade** > YAML view:
```yaml
redhat-developer-hub:
  upstream:
    backstage:
      extraEnvVars:
        - name: CUSTOMER_SUPPORT_URL
          value: https://your-support-portal.example.com
```
Click **Upgrade**, then hover over *Support* (top right) in the portal to check it.
